text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as data, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences, including context and tone. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, it enables automatic translation between languages, so you can read a foreign article instantly. It also performs sentiment analysis, which determines whether a review is positive, negative, or neutral. Furthermore, NLP is the brain behind chatbots, allowing them to answer questions and hold conversations naturally. From simple spell-checkers to complex virtual assistants, NLP makes human-computer communication smoother and more intuitive.
